description: Public Transit Demand Data is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Guangjing Zhou. A case study was conducted using the traffic network in Beijing, China. Travel demand data were sourced from bus smart card records collected between 7 a.m. and 9 a.m. on February 26, 2017. The area within the Sixth Ring Road of Beijing was divided into multiple travel demand spaces for generating travel demand. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
